coordinate_frame: physical base_link; meters/radians; no virtual base position joints
derivations: Retain all sourced trunk, arm, finger and fixed camera joint axes, origins and limits. Remove inertial/visual/mesh elements; native CuRobo spheres provide collision geometry.
Remove wheel/steering URDF branches because public proprioception does not expose their joint positions. Replace wheel spheres with conservative base-fixed enclosures; see wheel_enclosures.
Add both EEF links using official USD gripper-to-EEF localPos0=(0,0,-0.06), localRot0 wxyz=(0,0,1,0), equivalent to URDF RPY=(0,pi,0).
Remove USD-only base and joint flip settings. URDF already defines the negative torso_joint3 and second finger axes, so no additional sign flips apply.
Remove inactive attached-object placeholders. Held-object collision geometry is not implemented by this static model.
At request time lock observed trunk, opposite arm and all four finger positions; only selected arm seven joints are active.
